title: Uncapped windmill bearing
description: this mod add a windmill bearing that is uncapped wich mean that you can make a giant Wind turbine without being disturbed by create limits ! (this project is vibecoded)
body:
A mod that add an all new bloc to make wind turbine ! This block is the uncapped windmill bearing which allows you to make contraption above 8192SU ! Useful if you want your create word to look like it is using renewable sources of rotation !
--- INFORMATION ---
This mod is an extension to the [create mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) so you'll have to download it if you want it to work
